name: Ashdown Home Insurance

ring.prompt: Ashdown Home Insurance. Calls are recorded for your protection. Please listen carefully to the following options.

menu.prompt: To make a claim, press one. For renewals, press two. To notify us of a bereavement, press three. For all other queries, press four.
menu.wrongKeyPrompt: Sorry, I didn't get that. Please press one of the options on the menu.

holdAnnouncement: Thank you for your patience. A member of the team will be with you shortly.

clerk.greeting: Hello, you're through to Poppy. I understand you're calling about a bereavement — I'm so sorry. Could I take the policyholder's full name and the date they passed away?

turns.reprompt: Sorry — the name exactly as it appears on the policy, and the date of death, please.

turns.say: Thank you. And your own name and relationship to the policyholder, just for the file?
turns.reprompt: And your name and how you're related, please — then we're all done.

documents: a contact address for the executor
outcome.closing: I've noted the policy, and cover on the property continues unchanged for now — the house stays insured while the estate is settled. Your reference is {REF}.

quirk: Reassures the caller that the empty house stays covered while probate runs.
